new.title: Exact two-against-two column counts for every switched binary inner-product table
new.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (rowFlip colFlip : Fin (2^k) → Bool), 3 ≤ k →
  let N := 2 ^ k
  let bits := fun (v : Fin N) =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).filter (fun i => v.val.testBit i.val)
  let dot := fun (u v : Fin N) => ((bits u ∩ bits v).card % 2 == 1)
  let G := fun (u v : Fin N) => (dot u v != rowFlip u) != colFlip v
  ∀ (a b c d : Fin N), a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d →
    let split := Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N =>
      G a j ≠ G b j ∧ G a j ≠ G c j ∧ G a j = G d j)
    let parallelogram := (a.val ^^^ b.val ^^^ c.val ^^^ d.val) = 0
    let evenFlip := (rowFlip a != rowFlip b) = (rowFlip c != rowFlip d)
    split.card = if parallelogram then (if evenFlip then 2^(k-2) else 0) else 2^(k-3)

new.title: Coincident affine wire labels force a symmetric square with constant diagonal and charge twice the nonlinear gate count
new.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  2 ≤ n → 2 ≤ m →
  (∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → ∀ f : Bool, ∃ y, G i y ≠ xor f (G j y)) →
  (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → ∀ f : Bool, ∃ x, G x i ≠ xor f (G x j)) →
  (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) C →
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C →
  let b := C.gates.countP (fun g => g.inputs.length == 2)
  let t := C.gates.countP (fun g => (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
    xor (xor (g.op.eval [false,false]) (g.op.eval [false,true]))
        (xor (g.op.eval [true,false]) (g.op.eval [true,true])))
  ∃ (q : ℕ) (row : Fin q → Fin n) (col : Fin q → Fin m),
    Function.Injective row ∧ Function.Injective col ∧
    (∀ i j, G (row i) (col j) = G (row j) (col i)) ∧
    (∀ i j, G (row i) (col i) = G (row j) (col j)) ∧
    2*(n+m) ≤ b + 2*t + q + 4

new.title: The affine discrepancy of two biased inner-product banks lower-bounds binary cost at every nonlinear gate count
new.statement:
∀ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s →
  let k := 2*s
  let N := 2^k
  let V := Fin k → ZMod 2
  let dot := fun (x y : V) => ∑ j : Fin k, x j * y j
  ∀ (label : Fin N ≃ V) (Q R : V → ZMod 2) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) →
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C →
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j =>
      decide (dot (label i) (label j) + Q (label i) + R (label j) = 1)) C →
    let b := C.gates.countP (fun g => g.inputs.length == 2)
    let t := C.gates.countP (fun g => (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
      xor (xor (g.op.eval [false,false]) (g.op.eval [false,true]))
          (xor (g.op.eval [true,false]) (g.op.eval [true,true])))
    ∃ (T : V ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] V) (a : V) (e : ZMod 2),
      (∀ x : V, dot x (T x) = 0) ∧
      3*N + ((Finset.univ : Finset V).filter (fun x =>
        Q x + R (T x + a) ≠ dot a x + e)).card ≤ b + 2*t + 4

new.title: Normalizing binary inner product costs exactly one additional binary gate at the least nonlinear budget on two one-hot banks
new.statement:
∀ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s →
  let N := 4^s
  let T := Fin N → Fin N → Bool
  let dot := fun (x y : Fin N) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2*s))).filter (fun i =>
      x.val.testBit i.val && y.val.testBit i.val)).card % 2 == 1
  let quad := fun (x : Fin N) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s)).filter (fun i =>
      x.val.testBit i.val && x.val.testBit (s+i.val))).card % 2 == 1
  let signed := fun (x y : Fin N) => xor (xor (quad x) (quad y)) (dot x y)
  let b := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    C.gates.countP (fun g => g.inputs.length == 2)
  let t := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    C.gates.countP (fun g => (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
      xor (xor (g.op.eval [false,false]) (g.op.eval [false,true]))
          (xor (g.op.eval [true,false]) (g.op.eval [true,true])))
  let accepts := fun (H : T) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents H C ∧ t C ≤ s
  let exact := fun (H : T) (d : ℕ) =>
    (∀ C, accepts H C → t C = s ∧ 3*N ≤ b C + 2*s + d) ∧
    ∃ C, accepts H C ∧ t C = s ∧ b C + 2*s + d = 3*N

new.title: Conditional joint recovery of selected cyclic outputs from a criterion for affine products
new.statement:
let productCriterion : Prop :=
  ∀ (n t d : ℕ),
    let F := ZMod 2
    let V := Fin n → F
    let D := V →ₗ[F] F
    ∀ (a b c : Fin t → D) (u v e : Fin t → F),
      let target := fun (i : Fin t) (x : V) =>
        (a i x + u i) * (b i x + v i) + c i x + e i
      let run := fun (ask : Fin d → ℕ → D) (x : V) =>
        (List.finRange d).foldl (fun h j =>
          2 * h + (if ask j h x = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
      (∃ (ask : Fin d → ℕ → D) (readout : ℕ → Fin t → D)
          (bias : ℕ → Fin t → F),
        ∀ x i, target i x = readout (run ask x) i x + bias (run ask x) i) ↔
      (∃ pick : Fin t → D,
        (∀ i, pick i = a i ∨ pick i = b i ∨ pick i = a i + b i) ∧
        Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range pick)) ≤ d)
let conclusion : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), k % 3 ≠ 0 →
    let F := ZMod 2
    let W := Fin k → F
    let D := W →ₗ[F] F
    let ix := fun z : ℕ => (⟨z % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
    let rot := fun (q : ℕ) (x : W) (i : Fin k) => x (ix (i.val + k - q % k))
    ∀ (spacing s t : ℕ) (name c : W) (S : Finset (Fin k)) (d : ℕ),
      let out := fun (x : W) (i : Fin k) =>
        let z := rot s x + name
        let y := fun j : Fin k =>
          z j + z (ix (j.val + spacing)) + z (ix (j.val + k - spacing % k))
        y i + (1 + y (ix (i.val + 1))) * y (ix (i.val + 2)) + rot t x i + c i
      let mu := (S.powerset.filter (fun E => ∀ i ∈ E, ix (i.val + 1) ∉ E)).sup Finset.card
      let run := fun (ask : Fin d → ℕ → D) (x : W) =>
        (List.finRange d).foldl (fun h j =>
          2 * h + (if ask j h x = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
      let cost := if S = Finset.univ ∧ 1 < k ∧ k % 2 = 1 then mu + 1 else mu
      (∃ (ask : Fin d → ℕ → D) (readout : ℕ → Fin k → D) (bias : ℕ → Fin k → F),
        ∀ x, ∀ i ∈ S, out x i = readout (run ask x) i x + bias (run ask x) i) ↔
        cost ≤ d
productCriterion → conclusion

new.title: Exact joint height and leaf budgets for ordinary resolution trees after replacing each variable by a disjoint parity block
new.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (w : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < w i) →
  let Raw := (i : Fin n) × Fin (w i)
  let parity := fun (y : Raw → Bool) (i : Fin n) =>
    decide (Odd ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (w i))).filter (fun j => y ⟨i,j⟩ = true)).card)
  let liftAx := fun (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)))
      (A : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause Raw) =>
    ∃ C ∈ F, ∃ y : Raw → Bool, (∀ lit ∈ C, parity y lit.1 ≠ lit.2) ∧
      A = ((Finset.univ : Finset Raw).filter (fun b => b.1 ∈ C.image Prod.fst)).image
        (fun b => (b, !(y b)))
  let shape := fun (N J : Finset (List Bool)) =>
    [] ∈ N ∧ J ⊆ N ∧
    (∀ (p : List Bool) (b : Bool), p ++ [b] ∈ N → p ∈ J) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ J, p ++ [false] ∈ N ∧ p ++ [true] ∈ N
  let refutes := fun (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) (H K : ℕ) =>
    ∃ (N J : Finset (List Bool)) (line : List Bool → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause Raw),
      shape N J ∧ line [] = ∅ ∧ (∀ p ∈ N, p.length ≤ H) ∧ (N \ J).card ≤ K ∧
      (∀ p ∈ N \ J, liftAx F (line p)) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ J, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsResolvent
        (line (p ++ [false])) (line (p ++ [true])) (line p)
  let trace := fun {V : Type} (ask : List Bool → V) (p : List Bool) =>
    List.ofFn (fun j : Fin p.length => ask (p.take j.val))
  ∀ (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) (H K : ℕ),
    Iff (refutes F H K)
      (∃ (M A : Finset (List Bool)) (q : List Bool → Fin n),
        shape M A ∧ (∀ p ∈ M, (trace q p).Nodup ∧ ((trace q p).map w).sum ≤ H) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ M \ A, ∃ C ∈ F, ∀ lit ∈ C, ∃ j : Fin p.length,
          q (p.take j.val) = lit.1 ∧ p.get j ≠ lit.2) ∧
        (M \ A).sum (fun p => 2^(((trace q p).map w).sum - p.length)) ≤ K)

∀ (k r s : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2

  let layer := fun (gap : Nat) (x : W) =>
    let m := fun (j : Fin k) => x j + x (ix (j.val+gap)) + x (ix (j.val+k-gap%k))
    fun (j : Fin k) => m j + (1+m (ix (j.val+1))) * m (ix (j.val+2))
  ∀ (col : Bool) (raw : W) (delta : Fin s → W)
    (path : Fin (r+1) → Fin s → W) (test : Finset (Fin k)) (target : W),
    let initial := if col then 3 else 1
    let gap := if col then 2 else 1
    let inject := fun t : Nat => if col then 3*(t+1)+1 else 2*t
    let state := fun (data : W × (Fin r → W)) (key : W) (time : Fin (r+1)) =>
      ((List.finRange r).take time.val).foldl (fun v tick =>
        layer gap v + rot (inject tick.val) key + data.2 tick) (rot initial key + data.1)
    let weight := fun (t : Fin r) =>
      ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun v => ∀ p : Fin s,
        layer gap (v+path t.castSucc p) - layer gap v + rot (inject t.val) (delta p)
          = path t.succ p)).card

      (∀ t p, state data (raw+delta p) t - state data raw t = path t p) ∧
      (∀ j ∈ test, state data raw (Fin.last r) j = target j))).card =

        2^(k-test.card) * ∏ t : Fin r, weight t else 0)

    p^k * (1-p)^(n-k) ≤ 16*Real.sqrt ((n:ℝ)+1)*KT

changed.title: Shared Boolean circuits rank and select in every parameter fiber of a layered binary automaton
changed.statement:
∀ (l q : ℕ), 0 < l → ∀ (start : Fin q)
  (step : Fin l → Fin q → Bool → Bool → Fin q) (final : Fin q → Bool),
  let W := Fin l → Bool
  let good := fun p : W => Finset.univ.filter (fun u : W =>
    final ((List.finRange l).foldl (fun st j => step j st (p j) (u j)) start) = true)
  let key := fun w : W => ∑ i : Fin l, if w i then 2^(l-1-i.val) else 0
  let valid := fun C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2*l) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 512*(l+1)^2*(q+1)^2 ∧
    ∀ g ∈ C.gates, ((g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) ∨
      (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)
  ∃ (enc dec : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (ew : Fin l → Fin (2*l+enc.size)) (dw : Fin l → Fin (2*l+dec.size))
    (select : (p : W) → Fin (good p).card ≃ ↥(good p)),
    valid enc ∧ valid dec ∧ ∀ (p : W) (r : Fin (good p).card) (j : Fin l),
      let word := (select p r).val
      let idx := fun i : Fin l => r.val.testBit i.val
      ((good p).filter (fun other => key other < key word)).card = r.val ∧
      (enc.wires (List.ofFn p ++ List.ofFn idx)).getD (ew j).val false = word j ∧
      (dec.wires (List.ofFn p ++ List.ofFn word)).getD (dw j).val false = idx j

changed.title: Digit sums and a binary syndrome color every squared-distance bucket on a finite grid
changed.statement:
∀ (m b h : ℕ), 0 < b →
  let Q := 2^b
  let X := Fin m → Fin Q
  let width := m*Q^2 / 2^h + 1
  let distance := fun (x y : X) => ∑ j : Fin m, (Nat.dist (x j).val (y j).val)^2
  let bucket := fun (x y : X) => distance x y / width
  let f := 1+m+b*width
  let vec := fun (x : X) (i : Fin m × Fin b) => if (x i.1).val.testBit i.2.val then
    (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  (∀ x y : X, bucket x y < 2^h) ∧
    ∃ H : ((Fin m × Fin b) → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin f → ZMod 2),
      (∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m => x j ≠ y j)).card ≤ width →
        H (vec x) ≠ H (vec y)) ∧
      ∀ p q : X × X, p ≠ q → bucket p.1 p.2 = bucket q.1 q.2 →
        (∀ j, (p.1 j).val + (p.2 j).val = (q.1 j).val + (q.2 j).val) →
        H (vec p.1) = H (vec q.1) →
        bucket p.1 q.2 < bucket p.1 p.2 ∧ bucket q.1 p.2 < bucket p.1 p.2

changed.title: Exact cyclic support span of repeated mixed polar updates from one input bit at spacings one and two
changed.statement:
∀ (k d : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k), 11 ≤ k → (d = 1 ∨ d = 2) →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun a : ℕ => (⟨a%k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let mix := fun (v : W) (j : Fin k) =>
    v j + v (ix (j.val+d)) + v (ix (j.val+k-d%k))
  let polar := fun (z p : W) (j : Fin k) =>
    z (ix (j.val+1))*p (ix (j.val+2)) + z (ix (j.val+2))*p (ix (j.val+1))
  let step := fun S : Submodule F W =>
    Submodule.span F {w : W | ∃ v ∈ S, ∃ p : W, w = polar (mix v) p}
  ∀ start : Fin k,
    let e := fun (i j : Fin k) => if i = j then (1:F) else 0
    let seed := Submodule.span F ({e start} : Set W)
    let loc := fun (left offset : ℕ) => ix (start.val+k-left%k+offset)
    (∀ h : ℕ, (d = 1 ∨ h ≠ 1) → ∀ w : W,
      w ∈ (step^[h]) seed ↔ ∀ j : Fin k,
        (¬ ∃ b : ℕ, b ≤ (2*d+1)*h ∧ loc ((d+2)*h) b = j) → w j = 0) ∧
    (d = 2 → step seed =
      Submodule.span F ({e (loc 4 0), e (loc 4 5),
        e (loc 4 1) + e (loc 4 2), e (loc 4 3) + e (loc 4 4)} : Set W))

changed.title: Adaptive parity lookup rejection counts dominate an attainable sum of weighted binary kernel indicators
changed.statement:
∀ (m h q : Nat),
  let U := Fin h → ZMod 2
  let V := Fin m → ZMod 2
  let feasible := fun (label : U → V → Bool) =>
    ∃ (ask : (j : Fin q) → (Fin j.val → ZMod 2) → ((U × V) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2))
      (answers : U → V → Fin q → ZMod 2) (leaf : (Fin q → ZMod 2) → Bool),
      (∀ (u : U) (x : V) (j : Fin q), answers u x j =
        ask j (fun i => answers u x ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans i.isLt j.isLt⟩) (u,x)) ∧
      ∀ (u : U) (x : V), label u x = leaf (answers u x)
  let rejected := fun (label : U → V → Bool) (x : V) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset U).filter (fun witness => label witness x = false)).card
  let shape := fun (n : Nat) (depth : Fin n → Nat) =>
    (∀ i, depth i ≤ min h q) ∧ (∑ i : Fin n, 2^(h-depth i)) = 2^h
  let mass := fun (n : Nat) (depth : Fin n → Nat)
    (maps : (i : Fin n) → V →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin (q-depth i) → ZMod 2)) (x : V) =>
      ∑ i : Fin n, if maps i x = 0 then 2^(h-depth i) else 0
  (∀ label : U → V → Bool, feasible label → (∀ witness, label witness 0 = false) →
    ∃ (n : Nat) (depth : Fin n → Nat)
      (maps : (i : Fin n) → V →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin (q-depth i) → ZMod 2)),
      shape n depth ∧ ∀ x : V, mass n depth maps x ≤ rejected label x) ∧
  (∀ (n : Nat) (depth : Fin n → Nat)
    (maps : (i : Fin n) → V →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin (q-depth i) → ZMod 2)),
    shape n depth → ∃ label : U → V → Bool, feasible label ∧
      ∀ x : V, rejected label x = mass n depth maps x)

changed.statement:

changed.title: A signed permutation of binary coordinates has a simultaneous squared-imbalance budget away from fixed points
changed.statement:
∀ (n r : ℕ) (P : Fin r → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (e : Fin n → Bool),
  let X := Fin n → Bool
  let moved := fun j : Fin r => Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => P j i ≠ i)
  let imbalance := fun (z : X) (j : Fin r) =>
    let m := moved j
    let D := (m.filter (fun i => z i ≠ xor (z (P j i)) (e (P j i)))).card
    Nat.dist (2*D) m.card
  let total := ∑ j : Fin r, (moved j).card
  (∑ z : X, ∑ j : Fin r, (imbalance z j)^2) ≤ 2^n * (2*total) ∧
    ∀ A : ℕ, 0 < A →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : X => ∃ j : Fin r, A ≤ imbalance z j)).card * A^2
        ≤ 2^n * (2*total)

changed.statement:

    let run := fun (key : W) (j : Fin k) =>
      let z := rot s key + name
      let y := fun i : Fin k =>
        z i + z (ix (i.val + d)) + z (ix (i.val + k - d % k))
      y j + (1 + y (ix (j.val + 1))) * y (ix (j.val + 2)) + rot t key j + c j

changed.title: Counting permutations whose tagged symbols are constant under a prescribed linear projection
changed.statement:
∀ (r d : Nat), d ≤ r →
  let K := ZMod 2
  let V := Fin r → K
  let D := Fin d → K
  ∀ (f : V →ₗ[K] D), Function.Surjective f → ∀ tags : V → V,
    let flat := (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm V)).filter (fun p =>
      ∃ c : D, ∀ i, f (p i + tags i) = c)
    let balanced := ∀ j : D,
      ((Finset.univ : Finset V).filter (fun a => f (tags a) = j)).card = 2^(r-d)
    flat.card = if balanced then (2^d)*(Nat.factorial (2^(r-d)))^(2^d) else 0

changed.title: A truth-table cut of a successful translated-list selector contains a full OR restriction
changed.statement:
∀ (g m r : Nat),
  let A := Fin (m+1)
  let V := Fin g × Fin m × Fin r
  let W := V → Bool
  let deg := fun (b : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ b) ∧
      ∀ input, f input = (((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ j ∈ mon, input j = true)).card % 2) == 1)
  let Y := Fin g → A
  ∀ (label : Fin g → Fin m → A → Fin r → Bool) (pick : W → Y),
    (∀ x j i, (fun v => x (j,i,v)) ≠ label j i (pick x j)) →
    ∀ (test : Y → Bool) (base : Y) (coord : Fin g),
      let ones := ((Finset.univ : Finset A).filter (fun z =>
        test (Function.update base coord z) = true)).card
      0 < ones → ones < m+1 →
      ∀ b : Nat, deg b (fun word => test (pick word)) → max ones (m+1-ones) ≤ b

changed.context: Force each other group to return its fixed label. In the remaining group start at a word forcing b from the smaller side. Each raw bit is a constant, a switch or its complement. This substitution preserves the degree bound, while OR on the larger side has full degree.

changed.title: Low total query degree on a successful transcript forces many errors nearby for a list of translated predictions
changed.statement:
∀ (m r L d : Nat), 0 < L →
  let V := Fin m × Fin r
  let W := V → Bool
  let deg := fun (b : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ b) ∧
      ∀ input, f input = (((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ j ∈ mon, input j = true)).card % 2) == 1)
  let t := m/L
  let F := Fin t → Bool
  let run := fun (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (n : Nat) (x : W) =>
    (List.range n).foldl (fun h pos => h + ((ask pos h x).toNat <<< pos)) 0
  ∀ (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (leaf : Nat → Fin L → Fin m → Fin r → Bool) (base : W),
    let path := run ask d base
    (∃ a : Fin L, ∀ i, (fun v => base (i,v)) ≠ leaf path a i) →
    ∀ B : Fin d → Nat, (∀ u, deg (B u) (ask u.val (run ask u.val base))) →
    ∃ (driver : V → Option (Fin t)) (embed : F → W),
      (∀ flags site, embed flags site = xor (base site) ((driver site).elim false flags)) ∧
      Function.Injective embed ∧
      (∀ flags : F, (∃ z, flags z = true) → ∀ a : Fin L, ∃ i,
        (fun v => embed flags (i,v)) = leaf path a i) ∧
      2^(t - ∑ u : Fin d, B u) ≤ 1 +
        ((Finset.univ : Finset F).filter (fun active =>
          (∃ z, active z = true) ∧ run ask d (embed active) = path)).card

changed.context: Take t disjoint groups of L coordinates. On a switch, set the assigned coordinate of every candidate to its forbidden symbol. Each group changes at least one raw bit since one candidate was valid at the base. Switches are disjoint, hence injective. The indicator of the base path is a product of its answer literals and has degree at most D on this cube. It is one at zero. A nonzero Boolean polynomial of degree D on t bits has at least 2^max(t-D,0) nonzeros. All the other nonzeros are errors.
